verdict.rationale: GitLab says security findings from consolidated scanners appear directly in merge requests. A technology partner, CodeAnt AI, brings code-quality enforcement into GitLab merge requests. Together these suggest third-party analysis can surface in the review screen, though only through marketing-level claims. Missing for 10: any evidence on reviewing large diffs (performance, collapsing, file-by-file navigation); first-party documentation of a native code-quality report widget that ingests third-party report formats; hands-on or independent corroboration.
